usage: Layout reference only: FK-box keeps FlClash's page sections, order and navigation layout, implemented with stock Material 3 components and Material icons. No FlClash/prism_ui widgets, glyphs, shapes, shaders, motion or press effects are used (see flclash.md).

previousReference.note: The Compose UI was first translated from these v0.9.2 sources and re-aligned to v0.9.3 + prism_ui 63450c0 afterwards. The per-file files/adaptedFiles records of that Flutter import (source paths, SHA-256 and change notes) were removed with the flutter/ tree; read them from flclash-manifest.json at 6902a3d.

sources.changes: IP race concurrency, stagger, response limit, browser user agent and public-IP validation preserved; routed HTTP transport uses sing-box. A source wins only after its source-specific parser validates the public IP and country field; malformed or incomplete responses advance the race.
Eight IP query URLs and source order preserved.
IpInfo response fields adapted to Go JSON/trace parsers.

Google and GitHub reachability rule (checkReachable/statusFromCode): 2xx available with latency, 401/403/429/451 restricted, other codes unavailable, one retry after a timeout. Requests go through the FK-box egress probe (8 s ceiling); GitHub uses its favicon because the home page exceeds the probe's 128 KiB body limit.
Route-keyed answers with the 1.5 s settle and 5 s throttle of RoutedProbe; FK-box adds a two-minute re-check while the card is shown.
Card layout only: service badge with a notched status dot, latency in ms or the failure label; drawn with Slint and Simple Icons marks.
Separate upload and download cards with the peak of the charted samples; layout only.
Three counts (live connections, recent requests, DNS queries), the first two opening their request views; counts come from the FK-box connection stream.

supplementalReferences.name: mitm-dev
supplementalReferences.scope: Request and MITM certificate design only; the overall UI, Android and sing-box baselines stay unchanged. Local paths are relative to the repository root.

files.changes: GPL-3.0 license included in exported CA modules.
Unmodified installer entry, moved to its ZIP path.
Unmodified installer marker, moved to its ZIP path.

Reference for system/Conscrypt APEX and init/zygote/app mount namespaces. B-box builds a complete tmpfs copy separately in each target namespace before binding it, retains hash collisions, has no live stale-certificate removal, and logs failures.
Uses the B-box module-relative injector and resets this boot’s diagnostic log.
Uses the B-box injector’s --apps option to reach existing app namespaces.

Reference for Android CA identity, hash names, store/namespace limitations and public module export. B-box implements non-exportable Keystore signing, revision checks and AtomicFile persistence; no automatic root command or private-key export.
Distinguish user/system trust and refresh after returning from settings. B-box queries its local Android bridge and isolates remote sessions.

Reference for explicit CA operations, HTTPS inclusion/exclusion and certificate setup. B-box uses private capture settings and shared components; profile HTTP rewriting is a separate B-box implementation documented in libbox.md. Certificate rotation is blocked while either capture or profile processing uses it; no Mihomo configuration.
Reference for HTTP exchange information. B-box keeps bounded libbox records and its independent live Connections page.
Reference for per-message detail navigation; B-box retains its record menu and copyable rows with actual route/TLS metadata and trailers.
FEATURE_MITM is disabled by default in this reference. The public FlClash core is not used as an MITM backend.

supplementalReferences.name: geo-resources
supplementalReferences.scope: Geo data (GeoIP, GeoSite, MMDB, ASN) bundling, update and Resources page design for the Xray and mihomo cores; the overall UI, Android and core baselines stay unchanged. No FlClash source or data file is copied. Local paths are relative to the repository root.

files.changes: Auto update toggle, interval in hours, geo rows with size, last update, single update, URL edit with reset to default and copy link translated to Compose. Icon sets, rule providers, scripts and MITM modules are not carried over; the source (built in or downloaded) is shown beside the time.
Per-resource update with a failure banner and URL validation; updates run in the app through libbox instead of the mihomo core's updater.

initGeo extracts bundled assets into the core home; FK-box also replaces a bundled or downloaded file older than a newer bundle, never a newer download, and checks each extraction against the build's SHA-256.

defaultGeoXUrl (MetaCubeX/meta-rules-dat latest) kept as the default URLs; geo-auto-update off and geo-update-interval 24 hours kept as defaults. The bundled copy is pinned to a meta-rules-dat release-branch commit and verified by SHA-256 at build time instead of being committed.
Same four resources and parser checks as mihomo's updater (protobuf GeoIP/GeoSite, MaxMind DB); the file is written beside the target and renamed so a failed download keeps the old file.

supplementalReferences.name: flclash-record-filters
supplementalReferences.scope: FlClash v0.9.3 list infrastructure (scaffold title menu and keyword chips, record filters, grouping) translated to Kotlin + Jetpack Compose; no Dart or Flutter code is included.

files.changes: RecordFilter, RecordFacet (offered values by frequency, 12 max, fixed order then name), RecordGrouper, groupRecords and whereFilters (one facet widens, facets narrow).

RecordFilterController as Compose state, removable and pinned keyword lists, Filter and Group by menus (menus close on toggle: fk-box PopupMenuItem has no keepsOpen), RecordFilterScope as a CompositionLocal, recordGroupings saved per page in the interface preferences; RecordGroupedList as a LazyListScope extension with animateItem rows instead of SliverCollapsibleGroups' unfold fade.
titleMenuItems (title opens a popup over its start) and keywords (header strip under the bar; the body no longer runs under the bar while it shows).
_KeywordStrip (36 dp chips, 16 dp inset, 8/20 dp gaps, 4/16 dp padding) and _TitleMenuButton (chevron 20/16 dp, focus overlay only).

RequestsPage with title-menu feeds Recent requests (closed connections, Closed/All menu), Running (active, close-all) and fk-box's Captured HTTP list (sing-box only, greyed with the reason elsewhere; capture menu unchanged); requestFeed persisted; each feed keeps its own search, RecordFilterController and grouping (captured: MITM and app facets, app/host grouping). The connections.dart page is folded in; no per-connection exchange tabs (capture records carry no connection id).

QuickEditPage (monospace text editor with Save, edit guard; a failed apply shows its message with Discard changes? and stays open on cancel; QuickEditCancelled keeps it open) and ListQuickEditPage (one item a line, first three line issues). Hooked into capture HTTPS domains, exclusions, ports and applications, profile mitm.hosts/excluded_hosts, and ConfigListPage object lists as one JSON object a line; saves go through the existing draft/revision-checked setters.

parseListInput (line markup and quotes stripped, comma split, blanks/repeats dropped, max length and validator issues) and parseLineInput (whole lines); the rule-type comma exception, map input and existing-entry counting are not ported (no fk-box field uses them).

supplementalReferences.name: prism_ui-chip-collapsible
supplementalReferences.scope: Keyword chip and collapsible group header used by FlClash v0.9.3 (be84736) record lists, translated to Kotlin + Jetpack Compose; no Dart or Flutter code is included.

files.changes: Chip as KeywordChip on CommonCard: 36 dp full pill, 16/12 dp padding, close mark 16 dp, filled primary when a selected toggle.
CollapsibleHeader (label (count), trailing caption, chevron turning a quarter, 8/12 dp padding); groups start folded; no keyboard activate action.

note: fk-box: the Flutter module was removed after the Kotlin + Jetpack Compose translation, which lives in app/src/main/java/io/nekohasekai/sfa/compose. The former files/adaptedFiles lists (paths in the deleted flutter/ tree) are in Git history (flclash-manifest.json at 6902a3d).
